resources.name: ORCA quantum chemistry program (open-source substitute for Gaussian 98)

access.notes: Free for academic use; download and install locally.

resources.notes: Used to perform B3LYP DFT calculations and geometry optimizations.

resources.name: Basis set definitions for Si and Y (all-electron DZVP equivalent, def2-SVP, and Stuttgart/Dresden ECP)

access.notes: Required basis sets for the B3LYP calculations. Equivalent modern basis sets (def2-SVP, Stuttgart RSC 1997 ECP for Y) can be obtained from EMSL BSE.

resources.notes: The original paper used DZVP and SDDAll basis sets. Modern equivalents such as def2-SVP and the Stuttgart RSC ECP are acceptable.

resources.name: Reference geometries of pure Si_n, ScSi_n, and Si_{n+1} clusters from literature

access.notes: Published geometries for small silicon clusters (Si_n, n=1-7) and ScSi_n clusters are available in the scientific literature (e.g., Raghavachari, J. Chem. Phys. 1986, etc.) and can be used to construct initial YSi_n structures.

resources.notes: The agent should reconstruct initial geometries by substituting Y for Sc or Si in published structures.
